privacy.title: Privacy & Data Safeguards
privacy.subtitle: VyomFlow is designed with privacy-first architecture to protect your personal cognitive health journey.
privacy.localAudioDesc: Voice features (pause frequency, speech rate, pitch variation) during story recall and language tasks are extracted locally in your browser. Audio streams are discarded after feature computation.
privacy.encryptedStorageDesc: Your assessment results, interaction timings, and longitudinal trend indicators are encrypted during transmission and stored securely with strict account access controls.
privacy.healthControlDesc: You retain ownership of your assessment records. You can view your full history, export data summaries, or request account deletion at any time.
privacy.nonDiagnosticDesc: VyomFlow tracks personal functional patterns over time for wellness and self-awareness. It does not provide medical diagnoses or replace clinical evaluations.
privacy.faq1Q: Is my raw audio recording stored on server disks?
privacy.faq1A: No. Raw audio captured during spoken activities is processed in browser memory to compute numeric acoustic features. The raw audio buffer is automatically cleared after processing.
privacy.faq2Q: Are my results shared with third parties or advertisers?
privacy.faq2A: Never. VyomFlow does not sell participant health data or share personal assessment tracking with advertising networks.
privacy.faq3Q: How can I manage or delete my assessment history?
privacy.faq3A: You can inspect your previous records on the History page or manage your account settings from your user profile menu.

demo.aboutDesc1: This demo shows a simulated cognitive decline pattern. The data represents a user whose memory accuracy drops from 86% to 58% over 5 weeks, with corresponding increases in reaction time variance and decreases in pattern recognition scores.
